verdict.rationale: Poly lets you share files or folders with specific people, and Shared Drives give a team its own storage space with members and roles. That covers the 'share a space with collaborators' half of the story. On simultaneous editing, the evidence only shows that conflicting edits are preserved and recoverable through version history and flashback mode, which is a safety net rather than true co-editing. Missing for 10: real-time co-editing or merge of concurrent edits, explicit edit permissions for collaborators (folder sharing is described as letting people 'see' content), and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-user editing.
